title: MacNeal–Harder curved cantilever, hex8 with incompatible modes
source: MacNeal and Harder, 'A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy', Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1 (1985) 3–20: Fig. 5 (p. 7) geometry, material and mesh; Table 3 (p. 10) theoretical tip displacements

quantities.quantity: tip displacement along the in-plane load
quantities.reason: MacNeal and Harder grade an element A within 2% of the theoretical value on this prescribed coarse mesh (p. 14)
quantities.known_failure: 0.880 of the theory, grade C: straight-sided hex8 on six elements over 90° (MacNeal–Harder's HEXA(8): 0.880, Table 9 p. 15)

quantities.quantity: tip displacement along the out-of-plane load
quantities.reason: MacNeal and Harder grade an element A within 2% of the theoretical value on this prescribed coarse mesh (p. 14)
quantities.known_failure: 0.798 of the theory, grade D: out-of-plane bending with torsion on one element across (MacNeal–Harder's HEXA(8): 0.849)
